steps: Fill in the immigration form on voyage.gouv.tg; it routes you to the e-visa and online payment (card or mobile money).

Carry a yellow fever vaccination card.

laws.rule: Carry a copy of the photo page of your passport with you at all times. Make sure you’re able to access the original quickly if needed.
laws.heading: Personal ID

laws.rule: Possession, use or trafficking of illegal drugs is a serious offence and can result in fines and a prison sentence.
laws.heading: Illegal drugs and prison sentences

laws.rule: It’s illegal to take photographs of or near sensitive or official sites such as: military installations government buildings airport buildings
laws.heading: Using cameras in secure areas

laws.rule: Same-sex sexual relationships are illegal in Togo and penalties are severe. You could be fined or given a prison sentence. Read more advice for LGBT+ travellers .
laws.heading: LGBT+ travellers

laws.rule: Togo is a cash-based society so bring enough cash with you to cover your visit. Credit cards are not widely accepted. Some hotels and restaurants will accept credit cards, but card-paying machines are not reliable so you may be asked to pay in cash. Some ATMs in the capital, Lomé, accept international cards and dispense local currency.
laws.heading: Money
